Description: Never create dependent branches that include parent commits
Code_Example: Verify with: git log --oneline parent..current shows ONLY new commits

Description: Never ignore high commit counts in twig tree
Never force-push without verifying tree is clean
Code_Example: Check twig tree and commit counts first

Description: Never create multiple dependent branches without checking tree
Code_Example: Run twig tree after each branch creation

Description: Using merge instead of rebase pollutes history with merge commits
Code_Example: Use git rebase --no-edit or twig cascade

Description: Never import platform-specific files directly
Never use any instead of proper interfaces
Never disable ESLint rules instead of fixing root causes
Always test changes on both web and mobile platforms
Code_Example: Test both make build-web and make build-mobile

Description: Understanding how __PLATFORM_COMPONENTS__ works is essential
Never catch and hide errors instead of fixing root causes
Never work around problems instead of solving them properly
Do not start implementing changes on main; confirm you have switched to the ticket branch before modifying files
Code_Example: git status; git branch; twig switch LS-1234

Description: Leaving Jira statuses stale breaks handoffs; transition tickets at the beginning and end of every session
Code_Example: acli jira workitem transition --key LS-1234 --status "In Progress"

Description: Never commit real OAuth URLs API keys or secrets to git
Never commit .env.local instead of .env.example
Never use production URLs directly in code
Never make infrastructure changes through AWS Console
Never modify or delete Terraform state files manually
Never run terraform apply without reviewing plan first
Never add sensitive user operations to public GraphQL API
Never use expensive NAT Gateway for development
Never put OAuth Lambda outside VPC when database access needed
Code_Example: Lambdas need VPC for RDS access

Description: Baseball-Reference changed HTML attributes - always verify current format
Code_Example: Use data-stat='date' not 'date_game' for game identifiers

Description: Don't add fallbacks for old HTML formats that confuse future debugging
Code_Example: Check current HTML format before adding backwards compatibility

Description: Use database timestamps to correlate CloudWatch logs with events
Code_Example: Query last_updated/updated_at to find exact time range for logs

Description: trigger-game-selection calls remote Lambda not local code
Code_Example: Use dev server + env var for local testing

Description: If one game_identifier is empty check ALL games not just one player
Code_Example: SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE game_identifier IS NULL OR game_identifier = ''
